title: Project Galileo briefing and its two directives

tellings.quote: Galileo dealt with the propulsion system of the craft and

plain: A secret briefing paper called Project Galileo, read at a hidden Nevada site called S-4 in 1988 or 1989, "dealt with the propulsion system of the craft": that is, how the craft kept there were said to fly. Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at S-4 on craft that humans did not build, tells Michels he saw it himself, and he names a second paper too, a briefing for something called Project Looking Glass. If true, it would mean the government had written its own study papers on how such craft move.
